name: Best Buy
description: Best Buy is the largest US-focused consumer electronics retailer: it buys phones, laptops, TVs, appliances and games from vendors and resells them in about 1,068 stores and online, mostly in the US with a Canadian segment (8 percent of sales). Margins are thin (22.5 percent gross, 3.3 percent operating) because it sells other companies' products; it adds higher-margin income from services (Geek Squad, installation, memberships, warranties, health), its Best Buy Ads retail media business and a third-party Marketplace. FY2026 revenue was $41.7 billion (+0.4%), operating income $1.39 billion and net earnings $1.07 billion; computing and mobile phones is now 47 percent of domestic sales.

gics.note: Wikipedia list gives only sector and sub-industry; industry group and industry were not in a source read, so left null.

employees.note: About 82,000 in the US and Canada (FY2026 10-K)

businessLines.name: Domestic
businessLines.how: Buys branded electronics in volume and resells at a small markup (retail margin about 22 percent), then adds profit on services, memberships, advertising paid by vendors (Best Buy Ads) and marketplace commissions.
businessLines.description: US stores and online (incl. Best Buy Health, Best Buy Ads, Marketplace, Geek Squad)

businessLines.name: International (Canada)
businessLines.description: Best Buy, Best Buy Express and Best Buy Mobile in Canada

brands.name: Geek Squad, Best Buy Health, Best Buy Ads, Best Buy Marketplace, Best Buy Business
brands.note: Service and media lines; revenue not broken out except Services at 6% of domestic

brands.name: Insignia, Rocketfish, Pacific Kitchen and Home, TechLiquidators, Lively, Jitterbug
